key_reasoning.reason: The change hardens the sandbox runtime guard (filesystem_policy runtime prelude), a defense-in-depth security boundary for untrusted customer code. It covers lxml XXE/entity-expansion hardening, parser-type bypass resistance (raw base class, subclass, __eq__/__hash__ spoofing, positional parser args, iterparse subclassing) and audit-hook path authorization. There is a precedent pattern (the existing monkeypatch/audit-hook guard), but its bypass-resistance logic is new and security-sensitive. The work was scored M and bumped to L by the security red flag. The L floor for injection prevention also applies.

The production change is confined to one component, the render_runtime_prelude template in filesystem_policy.py. Its counterpart test module is the only other file changed. No layer boundary is crossed.
